entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: A plane ruled by monsters, where human civilization survives in a few heavily defended sanctuaries.

entities.name: Bonders
entities.description: Humans who form an eludha, a mystical bond, with a monster, and are hated by civilized humans as traitors.

entities.name: Eludha
entities.description: The deeply mystical bond that ties the spirit of a bonder and a monster together.

entities.name: Triomes
entities.description: Five major geographical regions of Ikoria, each with its own terrain, dominant clade of monsters and apex monster, formed by three types of mana mixing.

entities.name: Clades
entities.description: Five monster groups on Ikoria: Beasts, Cats, Dinosaurs, Elementals and Nightmares.

entities.name: The Ozolith
entities.description: A large crystal formation outside Drannith whose appearance, and alteration by a meddling planeswalker, spawned wild mutation; it was shattered by Lukka.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: A human sanctuary on Ikoria, destroyed by the compleated Lukka.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: Captain of Drannith's defense forces and a planeswalker who bonded with a monster, besieged Drannith, and later returned compleated.

entities.name: Compleated Lukka
entities.description: A Phyrexian-compleated Lukka who destroyed Drannith and amassed monsters into a titanic humanoid monstrosity, later vaporized by Vadrok's flame.

entities.name: General Kudro
entities.description: The General of Drannith killed during Lukka's siege.

entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: General Kudro's daughter, Lukka's fiancee, who helped arrange Ikoria's defense against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who, with no plane of her own to defend, arranged the defense of Ikoria against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Chevill
entities.description: A defender who helped arrange Ikoria's defense with Vivien and Jirina.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of the multiverse in which Ikoria was a target.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: The Phyrexian who led the main invasion force on Ikoria.

entities.name: Vadrok
entities.description: A monster whose flame vaporized Lukka's amalgam.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: An artifact whose omenpaths opened to Ikoria.

entities.name: Companion Legendaries
entities.description: Ten legendary monsters, plus Zilortha, Kogla and Yidaro, who defended Ikoria.

entities.name: Snapdax
entities.description: An Ikorian monster who took part in the invasion of Kamigawa through a massive Omenpath.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane invaded by Ikoria's monsters years after the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Meddling planeswalker
aliases: An unnamed planeswalker known for his meddling
entities.description: An unnamed planeswalker who changed something in the Ozolith, causing monsters to go mad and mutate, and bonding to begin.

entities.name: Hunters
entities.description: Individuals who hunt monsters for profit, vendetta or sport, mistrusted by civilized humans.

entities.name: Coppercoats
entities.description: Drannith's military, which paid bounties that drew hunters.

events.summary: The Ozolith crystal formation appears outside Drannith, spawning a new era of wild mutation.
events.quote: The appearance of a new crystal formation outside Drannith known as the Ozolith spawned a new era of wild mutation on Ikoria.

events.summary: Lukka bonds with a monster, is exiled, then besieges Drannith with monsters, killing the General, shattering the Ozolith and igniting his spark.
events.quote: killing the General, shattering the Ozolith, and igniting his planeswalker's spark in the process.

events.summary: Ikoria is targeted in the New Phyrexian Invasion and Vivien arranges its defense with Chevill and Jirina Kudro.
events.quote: Vivien took to arranging the defense of Ikoria alongside Chevill and Jirina Kudro .

events.summary: Lukka returns to Ikoria compleated, destroying Drannith and scattering its people.
events.quote: Lukka returned to Ikoria compleated, destroying Drannith and scattering its people.

events.summary: Vadrok's flame vaporizes Lukka's amalgam and more omenpaths of Realmbreaker open to Ikoria.
events.quote: After Lukka's amalgam was vaporized by Vadrok 's flame, more of Realmbreaker 's omenpaths opened to Ikoria.

events.summary: Vorinclex's invasion force devastates human culture while Ikoria's monsters turn on the invaders.
events.quote: Ikoria's monsters focused their ire upon the invaders rather than the local populace.

events.summary: Years later, Ikoria's monsters including Snapdax invade Kamigawa via a massive Omenpath.
events.quote: Ikoria's monsters, including Snapdax , invaded Kamigawa via a massive Omenpath .

relations.note: Lukka was the fiance of General Kudro's daughter Jirina.
relations.quote: fiancé of General Kudro 's daughter Jirina

relations.note: Killed the General during the siege of Drannith.
relations.quote: killing the General, shattering the Ozolith

relations.note: Captain of Drannith's defense forces before his exile.
relations.quote: the captain of Drannith 's defense forces
Vivien took to arranging the defense of Ikoria alongside Chevill and Jirina Kudro .

relations.note: Led the main invasion force on Ikoria.
relations.quote: Vorinclex's main invasion force continued the devastation of Ikoria's human culture

relations.note: Bonding is caused by his meddling with the Ozolith.
relations.quote: It is caused by an unnamed planeswalker's meddling with the Ozolith .

relations.note: Bonders are hated and considered traitors by the civilized humans.
relations.quote: Bonders are hated by the "civilized humans" and are considered traitors
